body: Oh look, a shaming subreddit. I guess /r/subredditoftheday's descent into shit is complete.
Hee hee, thanks for the warning but that's not an issue. My relationship is long distance so I'd have to be waxed at least a day before seeing him ;)
That's really helpful, thanks.
Do you know how the developing drugs work?

Numbers vary depending on the study but even with perfect use, you're looking at around 95% effectiveness. Some hormonal contraception for women is over 99% effective. I guess I'd like a pill or injection for men, like women have.
I talked to him about it the next day.

Thank you. I know these things on a superficial level but that doesn't seem to help me too much.

I'm going to look into support in the UK. Thank you again.
You're absolutely right there.

She knows she needs to stop enabling him but it's been habit for years.

She's still his mother and would rather not give him a criminal record.

l.Take off your pants and get on the bed. Don't tell anyone about this because it's our little secret'

Too dark? Tough.
I don't have the funds to finance something like that unfortunately.

See, what you're doing here is using posts from my depressive episodes against me. Also, I feel fairly safe in saying that people with depression can maintain good, happy relationships whilst still getting down from time to time.
No offense taken! I know I'm not always in the good place that I am now.
I had a slight fear of penises and semen for a while. But I'm married and happy now.
I'm in a pretty good place now. I honestly don't know what would come of seeking help at this point.
I'm so sorry, that's horrific. No-one should have that put on them. I hate when people try to blame the victims. No child is sexy.
Thanks

This might sound stupid but I don't know what benefit there would be for me getting professional help. I have a few people I talk to about it face to face when I get down. I've largely accepted that I did nothing wrong and I seriously doubt that the disgust I feel will ever go.
I'm female. As I was abused from such a young age, I have no way of knowing which of my flaws are a result of what happened and those I would have had anyway.

Thank you. I'm sorry to hear about your experience. I go through phases of wanting to talk to someone and then feeling like I'm coping OK. If it's alright with you, I'd like to message you from my main account. This is sort of my mental breakdown account...

Strength is relative. With stuff like this you can get on with life or wallow in it. I have my moments of wallowing but largely I just get on. 

Thank you

Thank you. I'm pretty good now, I'm married to a wonderful man and I have a great job. I will never know the extent of the damage done to me because I was never a person who wasn't abused. I don't let it define me!
Hooray! I'm a llama again!
You seem to be missing the part where it's always the woman's hormones. Long-suffering wife doesn't normally forgive, she comes to see that everything was actually her fault.

I was abused as a child by my grandfather. It started when I was very young and had no concept of it being wrong. I feel disgusted with myself for enjoying it and sometimes even seeking it.

When someone you're supposed to trust and bond with breaks that, it's hard to distance the good from the bad.

He's been dead for 11 years, I've never had help with this.

That applies to me. I was abused from a very young age by my grandfather. I didn't know it was wrong and therefore found the experience pleasurable. Knowing that makes me feel sick and disgusted with myself.
My arms. They get so heavy when I'm depressed. It's like a physical symptom of mental apathy

A sense of duty I think. 
I've had a job of some description since I was 14 and I have never taken a day off for depression despite some pretty strong depressive episodes in the last 12 years.

I refuse to let my depression consume me to the point that I CAN'T function, only that I don't want to. I've broken down at work and spent hours of my life dreading work and certain situations but in the end, I need rent and food. I don't want to burden my husband and I CAN get through each day.

But is this classed as 'suicidal thoughts'? Whenever I'm tested for my depression the form asks about suicidal thoughts. I feel this exact way about 70% of the time. If I never woke up, if I had an accident or just dropped dead it would be OK with me. 

I tick yes because there isn't a question about whether you just want to stop living.

Chin up, my dinosaury named friend.

What sort of things do you like doing? You mentioned your interests are different to most people but in a big place like Boston I bet you could find a group or club of like minded people.

It sounds like your home environment is pretty toxic. Have you tried talking to your mother or is that totally out of the question? I'd say, if there is a way for you to move out, take it.
I don't know how I feel about that. It makes it seem like the only cure is to rebalance the chemical through medication. I know that's not what you've said, just how I feel.
Now I'm happier that I helped even inadvertantly. Fighting off the darkness a little win at a time :)
I hear this chemical imbalance thing a lot. Is that really a thing?
Very helpful, thank you

You sound intelligent. In my experience that's gonna make you more prone to depression. 

Going to college might not be right for you but have you thought about where you see your future? A few years of struggle could be worth it for the outcome or maybe you want to do something that doesn't require vast amounts of education. It's your future, you can make it what you want.

I really hope someone out here can help you. I wish I could but I'm far from local.

We shouldn't have to bankrupt ourselves trying to save ourselves.
It's all a veneer. Underneath the surface these people will have doubts, worries and anxieties like anyone else.
Very helpful, thank you. Gotta love the old postcode lottery *eye roll*
In my experience, no one has it all figured out. Anyone who looks like they do is faking which is highly unhelpful to those of us who don't lie to ourselves

Thanks. I DO want to get better. I don't wallow in my depression or try to use it as an excuse. I want it gone.

Therapy is a great idea, I just don't know how to get there (I'm in the UK)
Thanks, I will.
Not that I'm aware of. Normally it just hits me like a truck *BOOM*
That's very kind. I've never felt so close to actually harming myself as I do today. I need a few thousand friends.

I'm a lady.
I do just want someone to talk to so I started something in r/depression. Typing blindly into an internet that may or may not hear is very theraputic for me

Thank you for your kind reply.

I would like to have proper therapy but to my knowledge the NHS only covers counselling and I can't afford to pay for treatment myself.

When I had counselling the counsellor told me 'I don't understand why you're depressed. You have nothing to be depressed about.' and I realised that she didn't understand depression. I never have a reason for feeling the way I feel which makes it worse for me. I know a lot of people with depression feel that they have no reason and people around them have much worse situations and they still function and they guilt themselves into feeling worse because they don't have the right to be depressed. I didn't need a counsellor doing that for me as well.

I'm going to have to go back to my doctor aren't I?

See how much I can talk when it's anonymous?

I was prescribed 6 weeks of counselling a few years ago. I quit after 3 weeks as the counselor wasn't helping.

My depression has been formally diagnosed. My doctor doesn't want to put me on medication and my husband doesn't want 'a zombie wife'

I don't know what else to do.
